name: Cape Town
summary: Cape Town combines Table Mountain, urban beaches like Camps Bay and one of the most established technology scenes in Africa, known as 'Silicon Cape', with a cost of living much lower than that of the major European capitals. Its time zone (UTC+2) barely differs one hour from Spanish time, which makes it easier to coordinate with clients or teams in Europe, although it is worth keeping in mind that citizen insecurity rates are considerably higher than in most nomadic destinations.
